title: AuraAuth
description: Modern authentication plugin for Paper servers with login, register, sessions, and security protection.
body:
AuraAuth is a lightweight and modern authentication plugin for Paper and Purpur Minecraft servers.

It provides a secure login and registration system to protect player accounts and prevent unauthorized access. The plugin is designed to be fast, simple, and easy to configure, making it suitable for both small and large servers.

AuraAuth includes session support so players can stay logged in for a configurable time. It also adds protection systems that prevent unauthenticated players from moving, using commands, or taking damage before logging in.

Features
- Secure register and login system
- Session-based auto login
- Login timeout system
- Movement restriction before login
- Command blocking before authentication
- Damage protection before login
- Hidden password input in chat
- SQLite database support
- Lightweight and optimized performance
- Fully customizable messages
- Supports modern Paper and Purpur versions

Commands
- /register <password>
- /login <password>

Permissions
- auraauth.admin

Supported Platforms
- Paper
- Purpur

Notes
AuraAuth is designed for servers using offline-mode authentication setups and focuses on providing a smooth and secure login experience without external dependencies.
